newsitem.title: UK: Hoogovens hopes for Boel deal by year end.
newsitem.headline: Hoogovens hopes for Boel deal by year end.

text.p: Dutch steel and aluminium group Hoogovens said on Thursday that it hoped to reach agreement on taking a 50 percent stake in privately-held Belgian steel company Usines Gustav Boel by the end of the year.

Chairman Maarten van Veen told reporters that Hoogovens was interested in Boel's rolling mills in La Louviere in Belgium and Maubeuge in Northern France, which have a combined capacity of one million tonnes per year.

Van Veen said Hoogovens and Boel both agreed crude steel production in La Louviere was uneconomic and would probably have to end, but there was a future for the rolling mills if Boel was restructured.
He said the Boel rolling mills would help Hoogovens overcome an imbalance between its crude steel output of some six million tonnes a year and its rolling capacity of 4.3 million tonnes.
